description: Tests first: connector required, scoped display/edit, forged target rejection, routing rollback and disabled management. Extend PeopleGateway channel commands for transactional save plus routing; reuse AgentRouting validation and IncomingMessageRouting.apply_rule_commands persistence. UI caches reference datasets; no DB during validate. Approved DS components. Docs owners updated.

comments.text: Simplification: remove PersonChannelRouting module; incoming-message management discovery and scoped form commands belong to existing IncomingMessageRouting, reuse AgentRouting conversion and persistence. PeopleGateway preserves transaction for channel + rules. Existing regression tests retained/moved to owner, not a parallel routing engine.

PersonChannelRouting module deleted; its regression file moved to IncomingMessageRoutingPeopleTest and all surviving tests invoke existing IncomingMessageRouting owner. Shared scope/choice validation converts channel form into ordinary incoming-message rules; gateway transaction still rolls back channel changes on forged/invalid targets. Obsolete references removed. 757-test focused validation green.

Approved review corrections in progress: remove BO form decoding/discovery from IncomingMessageRouting; keep only its Person rule query. Reuse existing apply_rule_commands/2 and PeopleGateway atomic channel save, extending the gateway to accept separate canonical rules and validate persisted person/config/retrieval/topic scope (including clear commands). Move discovery/default resolution to existing ChannelConfig queries. Extend AgentRoutingOptions with shared rule input (reuses ZaqWeb.Select) and pure form adapter; no parallel routing persistence. Human approved reuse of Select for provider/retrieval/topic controls. Configuration resolution and form conversion are local-only implementation details, not independently exposed Actions/tools; gateway remains BO Engine event boundary. Missing/ambiguous defaults and invalid explicit connectors return controlled errors with atomic rollback. Existing EmailBridge delivery remains unchanged. Verify creation without configured bridge, receiving discovery in historical backfill, source form roundtrips, forged canonical scopes/clear commands and rollback.

Four review comments implemented. Migration now calls Bridge.incoming_routing with stored settings; populated pre-scope upgrade replay passed on _c_upgrade4. Removed default_connector behaviour callback and CommunicationBridge.binding_connector; ChannelConfig.resolve_person_channel_connector owns explicit/default resolution, rejects invalid explicit origins and works without configured bridge. IncomingMessageRouting diff versus PR base is now only list_person_rules/1 (6 lines); no BO form parsing/discovery. Shared AgentRoutingOptions.rule_select uses existing Select for all three scopes; its pure adapter emits numeric-ID canonical rule commands. Gateway retains strict person/config/retrieval/topic validation including clears and atomic persistence via existing apply_rule_commands. Source scopes cache/validate without DB reads. Added Storybook example and updated owning service docs. mix q passed; wider regression suite passed 765 tests +19 properties; final targeted rerun passed 95 tests +2 properties after additional no-fallback/rollback assertions. git diff --check clean for staged and unstaged. Existing E2E failures and historical replay blockers tracked on zaq-s04.5; no commit/push.
